item.title: Scaling up pre-exposure prophylaxis: A global analysis of processes and challenges regarding the implementation of the pre-exposure prophylaxis guidelines
item.description: Background: Pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) guideline implementation varies widely across countries as a result of differences in health systems, resources, and HIV priorities. item.description: Background: Mental health is a fundamental component of overall well-being and a critical determinant of academic success and professional functioning. item.title: Exploring factors affecting nurses’ job satisfaction at a regional hospital in Namibia
item.description: Background: Job satisfaction encapsulates the degree to which employees perceive fulfilment in various facets of their work, including the stability of their position, opportunities for professional development and confidence in their capability to execute tasks successfully. item.description: Background: An estimated one in seven adolescents globally experiences a mental disorder, and parents, as primary caregivers, play an essential role in caring for their adolescent with a mental disorder. item.description: Background: HIV and AIDS continues to be a critical public health challenge, with sub-Saharan Africa shouldering the heaviest burden. item.description: Background: Nurse educators are instrumental in preparing the next generation of nurses.
